title: Rewinding after a borrow
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $p$ be an allowed input-head position, let $u$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $b$ be a Boolean. For every integer $j$ with $0\le j\le |u|$, the one-tape debit machine started in the borrow-result state carrying $b$, with its head at position $j-1$ and tape containing $u$, reaches after $j+1$ steps the terminal result state carrying $b$, with its head at zero and its tape still containing $u$.
